principles: Do not duplicate live or indeterminate work
Keep explicit subprocess deadlines distinct from host-native agent liveness
drivers: Observed Claude agents complete well after ten minutes
Duplicate reviewers can race on review evidence and waste provider budget
Guidance is duplicated across four production prompt entrypoints

options.name: A: Status-first canonical guidance
pros: Works across Claude and Codex host-native task APIs
Small scoped change with testable wording contract
cons: Guidance depends on each host exposing a status mechanism
Does not create a new scheduler

options.name: B: Increase the fixed timeout
cons: Any fixed duration still misclassifies legitimate longer work
Does not distinguish alive from dead

options.name: C: Build a new scheduler and task registry
cons: Not necessary to correct the unsafe restart policy

rationale: The defect is an invalid inference from elapsed time to task death. Status-first guidance removes that inference across existing host-native runtimes without weakening explicit subprocess safety deadlines or expanding into a new scheduler.

preMortem.scenario: A host reports a task as running indefinitely even though useful progress stopped
preMortem.trigger: Repeated authoritative status polls stay running with no completion or failure
preMortem.mitigation: Require periodic observable status reporting and allow escalation to the user/supervisor, but do not duplicate until a conclusive terminal or operator cancellation signal exists.

preMortem.scenario: A host cannot query a previously launched task
preMortem.trigger: Task status lookup returns unknown or temporarily unavailable
preMortem.consequence: The controller might restart a still-live task
preMortem.mitigation: Treat unknown as non-authoritative and monitor-only; record uncertainty and ask the host/user for recovery rather than spawning a duplicate.

preMortem.scenario: Prompt copies drift and one entrypoint retains the ten-minute rule
preMortem.trigger: A future edit changes only story-dispatch or transition effects
preMortem.consequence: Some phases still duplicate long-running agents
preMortem.mitigation: Centralize the policy string/helper and add regression assertions across INIT, item dispatch, and REVIEW next steps, plus a repository scan for forbidden elapsed-time restart wording.

preMortem.scenario: The change accidentally disables real subprocess deadlines
preMortem.trigger: Shared timeout wording is edited too broadly
preMortem.consequence: codex exec or validation subprocesses can hang without bounds
preMortem.mitigation: Limit changes to host-native agent guidance and add explicit documentation/test language that subprocess timeout mechanisms remain unchanged.
